verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.replit.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs, including a 218-page Features markdown bundle. The docs are also served as raw .md pages (e.g. agent-modes.md, connect-via-mcp.md), which an agent can read directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance beyond the index, no independent reports of agents actually using these docs, and the probe shows only a thin snippet of llms.txt content.
